name: Humanitarian Shelter for the Lives of Social Leaders in Colombia
content: Problems and Purpose The Humanitarian Shelter for the Lives of Social Leaders was a democratic initiative implemented from April 28 until May 2, 2019. The Shelter had four objectives: to inform and raise awareness among citizens; to carry out an exercise of political control over the national government; to propose collective protection measures; and finally to inform the international community about the systematic assassinations of social leaders that have occurred since the signing of the peace agreement between the national government and the FARC in 2016.
